docs.ts:
/**
   * Recalls a memory pack.
   *
   * `effort: "high"`, `"xhigh"`, or `"max"` needs a lease this package never
   * mints: an embedded client returns `LEASE_REQUIRED`; a remote one gets what
   * the server serves (reranked on its `[models]` reranker, or unreranked and
   * saying so). `effort: "call"` is call mode for live calls: light
   * effort under a hard deadline (`deadlineMs`, or the vault's call-mode
   * deadline), answering with the best results ready, marked `partial`.
   */
docs.py:
Recalls a memory pack.

        ``effort="high"`` needs a lease this package never mints: an embedded
        client raises ``LEASE_REQUIRED``; a remote one gets what the server
        serves (reranked on its ``[models]`` reranker, or unreranked and
        saying so). ``effort="call"`` is call mode for live calls:
        light effort under a hard deadline (``deadline_ms``, or the vault's
        call-mode deadline), answering with the best results ready, marked
        ``partial``. ``format`` takes the engine's exact tokens:
        ``"json"``, ``"yaml"``, ``"toon"``, ``"md"``, ``"txt"``.

verbs.name: self.browser.library.run
verbs.description: Runs a replay library program live with its arguments; a missed postcondition goes back to the planner.

verbs.name: self.desktop.open
verbs.description: Opens an app of the run's own desktop guest by app:name and observes its window.

verbs.name: self.desktop.observe
verbs.description: Observes the current window of the run's desktop guest.

verbs.name: self.desktop.find
verbs.description: Finds the window rows whose role and name match.

verbs.name: self.desktop.click
verbs.description: Clicks one window target and observes the result.

verbs.name: self.desktop.click_at
verbs.description: Clicks a point of a held screenshot, mapped onto the window.

verbs.name: self.desktop.type
verbs.description: Types text into one window target and observes the result.

verbs.name: self.desktop.select
verbs.description: Sets the value of a combo box or list target by its option label.

verbs.name: self.desktop.key
verbs.description: Presses one key, with modifiers, on a window target or the window's focus.

verbs.name: self.desktop.hotkey
verbs.description: Presses a key combination in the current window.

verbs.name: self.desktop.scroll
verbs.description: Scrolls a window target, or the window, by steps.

verbs.name: self.desktop.wait_for
verbs.description: Waits until some window row matches a role and name.

verbs.name: self.desktop.expect
verbs.description: Checks that a window row is present or absent, and holds a given value.

verbs.name: self.desktop.screenshot
verbs.description: Takes a screenshot of the window the session holds, by image ref and never captioned.

verbs.name: self.desktop.view
verbs.description: Reads back a held image by its ref.

verbs.name: self.desktop.crop
verbs.description: Crops a held image to a rectangle.

verbs.name: self.desktop.zoom
verbs.description: Zooms into a rectangle of a held image.

verbs.name: self.desktop.batch
verbs.description: Runs one batched program of desktop steps for a subgoal, stopping at the first step that fails.

verbs.name: self.desktop.windows
verbs.description: Lists the desktop guest's windows, or one app's.

verbs.name: self.desktop.window
verbs.description: Moves the session onto another desktop window and observes it.

verbs.name: vault.commit
verbs.description: Commits claims through the gate, each element decided on its own; rejected elements come back rejected and do not persist.

verbs.name: vault.remember
verbs.description: Commits one claim through the gate, the same as vault.claims.upsert.

verbs.name: vault.claims.retract
verbs.description: Retracts one active claim: a deliberate withdrawal that preserves the record.

verbs.name: vault.forget
verbs.description: Retracts claims by exact claim or by subject and predicate; never a hard delete.

verbs.name: vault.claims.list
verbs.description: Lists claims by subject, predicate and lifecycle, with the read's narrowing receipt.

verbs.name: vault.claims.history
verbs.description: The supersession timeline of one claim, oldest first, with the read's narrowing receipt.

verbs.name: vault.delete
verbs.description: Deletes one entity under a named reason; an owner verb that only a verified human may call.

verbs.name: vault.writes.pending
verbs.description: Gated writes parked for consent, newest first.

verbs.name: vault.hydrate
verbs.description: Hydrates short refs or hex ids to full entity views, with the read's receipt.

verbs.name: vault.get
verbs.description: Reads one entity as a typed view, or none when absent or withheld; the receipt says which.

verbs.name: vault.refs.resolve
verbs.description: The bounded preview of one record ref, read through the caller's own scope; unreadable and missing look the same.

verbs.name: vault.refs.links
verbs.description: A text, or a turn's readable messages, as typed spans whose record links resolve under the caller's own read.

verbs.name: vault.search.bm25
verbs.description: BM25 text search over the engine index; surfaceable claims only.

verbs.name: vault.neighbors
verbs.description: The weighted-edge neighbourhood of one entity, filtered by edge kind and minimum weight.

verbs.name: vault.structural.put
verbs.description: Puts one structural record with its text-index fields and outgoing edges, in one atomic batch; claims go through commit.

verbs.name: vault.habits.checkin
verbs.description: Appends one immutable check-in under a Habit TASK.

verbs.name: vault.claims.admit
verbs.description: Admits one imported-evidence claim through its ingest source's trust ceiling; the gate still decides.

verbs.name: vault.artifacts.put
verbs.description: Registers one blob artifact; its bytes ride vault.artifacts.append.

verbs.name: vault.artifacts.append
verbs.description: Appends one version of bytes to a blob artifact's append-only chain.

admission.validate: if input.content_base64.len() > crate::memory::caps::MAX_BLOB_BASE64_LEN { return Err(MemoryError::bad_request("blob base64 exceeds the content ceiling")); }

verbs.name: vault.artifacts.read
verbs.description: Reads one version of a blob artifact's bytes.

verbs.name: connector.outbound.schedule
verbs.description: Schedules one send through a granted outbound connector, gated and held for delivery.

verbs.name: vault.notes.create
verbs.description: Creates a NOTE of a registered kind, its first authored text as its birth.

verbs.name: vault.notes.from_entity
verbs.description: Creates a NOTE of a registered kind from an existing entity.

verbs.name: vault.notes.edit
verbs.description: Edits one NOTE in a transaction-local document; a rejected edit leaves nothing pending.
